meta.note: decode[i].expected is decodeWavForEmbedding(wav) (16 kHz mono f32, exact) or null. windows[i].windows lists the lengths embedAudio hands the worker for a recording of `samples` 16 kHz samples. features[i] runs the processor feature extractor on 16 kHz mono samples built from `signal`: rows keeps whole feature rows by index, rowSums sums every row, validFrames is the length of the mask prefix of ones, softTokens counts the mask at every 4th frame. Recipes: see generate-audio.mjs recipeSamples.

decode.divergence: the native decoder refuses sample rates under 4000 Hz (a tiny file would claim hours)
